report.summary: daedalus/build.py: Orchestrates build session planning, defining BuildTask/Wave/BuildSession dataclasses, chunking tasks into waves, detecting path conflicts, and persisting sessions with optional bookkeeping updates.

daedalus/build.py|class|BuildSession|Tracks one feature across waves, the unit of coordinated build
